overview_markdown:
# 8-Week General Fitness Performance Plan

- **Goal**: Build general fitness and performance capacity
- **Structure**: 4 days/week (Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat) — strength, conditioning, and skill work
- **Progression**: Volume increases weeks 1-5, intensity peaks weeks 6-7, taper week 8
- **Key Focus**:
  - Barbell strength foundation with compound movements
  - Metabolic conditioning to improve work capacity
  - Movement quality and injury prevention

phase_breakdown.description: Establish movement patterns and work capacity. 3x5-8 rep compound lifts, moderate conditioning 2x/week.
Increase volume and intensity. Add accessory work, progress to 4x8 lifts, intensify conditioning with intervals.
Peak intensity on strength and short-duration conditioning. Reduce volume, sharpen performance capacity.
Reduce volume 40%, maintain intensity. Recovery week before target event.
